tieu_de: Cloud DevOps Engineer Azure/AWS Red Hat

mo_ta_cong_viec:
Design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure on AWS and/or Azure.
Build and manage CI/CD pipelines for application deployment and automation.
Administer and troubleshoot Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) environments.
Deploy and manage container platforms (Kubernetes/OpenShift).
Automate infrastructure provisioning using IaC tools.
Monitor system performance, availability, and security.
Collaborate with development teams on cloud migration and application modernization projects.
yeu_cau:
At least 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Infrastructure, System Administration, or Platform Engineering.
Strong experience with AWS or Azure cloud services.
Solid Linux administration experience, preferably RHEL.
Experience with CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.).
Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and/or OpenShift.
Familiar with Terraform, Ansible, Bash/Shell scripting.
Experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.
Good troubleshooting, communication, and English skills.
Nice to Have
Banking/Financial Services experience.
OpenShift certification or cloud certifications (AWS/Azure).
Experience with DevSecOps and Security Hardening.
